card.name: Check-ups and exams after a body-part word
card.fires_on: The word that ends a medical examination term, such as "ups" in "check-ups" or "exam" after physical, eye, ophthalmic or neurological. It appears in label advice about being examined.

modes.label: Dental check-ups
modes.description: The ending "ups" in "dental checkups" in advice to see a dentist regularly.
modes.example: Refer patients to dental care services for regular dental check<<ups>> while taking BRINSUPRI.

modes.label: Exam after a type of exam
modes.description: "exam" or "exams" after physical, eye, ophthalmic or neurological.
modes.example: obtain a physical and neurological<< exam>>, and consider MRI.

modes.label: Self-exam split word
modes.description: The "am" piece of "self-exam" in breast self-exam.
modes.example: Frequent breast self-ex<<am>> or frequent breast stimulation
